title: Precise giants: New research reveals how blue whales find food in a vast ocean

beats.caption: Precise giants: New research reveals how blue whales find food in a vast ocean
We might finally stop ships from hitting endangered blue whales.
beats.detail: New research changes how we protect them.
beats.narration: We might finally stop ships from hitting endangered blue whales. It starts with how they find food.

beats.caption: Despite protections, these giants still risk fatal collisions with ships.
beats.detail: Ship strikes remain a major threat.
beats.narration: Despite strict protections, these massive animals are still at risk of fatal collisions with cargo ships.

beats.caption: MBARI scientists are now mapping exactly how they hunt for krill.
beats.detail: Their technology tracks both whales and food.
beats.narration: To help, scientists at MBARI are mapping exactly how whales hunt for krill in Monterey Bay.

beats.caption: They use a suite of ocean technologies to watch the bay.
beats.detail: Advanced sensors monitor the underwater environment.
beats.narration: They are using a suite of advanced ocean technologies to watch the bay in real time.

beats.caption: This data helps experts predict where whales will be feeding next.
beats.detail: Better maps mean smarter shipping routes.
beats.narration: This data helps experts predict where whales will be feeding, so we can adjust shipping routes.

beats.caption: It gives officials the evidence they need to save the population.
beats.narration: It gives officials the hard evidence they need to create better conservation policies for the population.
